summary: Closed the remaining T62 F-004 residuals T68 disclosed but did not own: the init interactive prompt and five documentation files that still described only `enforced`/`ci` as blocking, omitting `gateway` (which T61/T65/T68 already made block identically at the write seam, the flow completion gate, and every command exit code). Enumerated sites via ctx rg across docs, .metaproject/modules, and src/commands (four search passes plus a raw-log read after the compacted summary undercounted one file's hit list), verified each hit's surrounding paragraph by direct Read, and cross-checked current behaviour directly against src/security/guard.ts (isBlockingMode) and src/security/types.ts (SecurityMode) rather than trusting prior task prose. Corrected 15 in-scope sites (src/commands/init.ts:497 prompt string; .metaproject/modules/security.md; docs/docs/architecture.md x2 + a heading disambiguation; docs/docs/modules.md x3; docs/docs/workspace-and-lifecycle.md x2; docs/docs/cli-reference.md x5) plus one out-of-list site corrected under the dispatch's own 'same sentence' exception (.metaproject/core/security/README.md, this repo's own stale checked-in copy of the templates.ts output T68 already fixed at the source). Left docs/docs/cli-reference.md:2086-2099 untouched per the explicit constraint. No behaviour changed: only prose/string edits. No code defect found in this pass.
